plan: An assassin who teleports from dagger to dagger and chains takedowns in fights.
aSurveiller: Her R (Death Lotus). She spins and throws knives at nearby enemies: interrupt her with a stun or move away.
contrer: Keep a stun for her R: it interrupts it instantly.
Don't stand near her daggers on the ground: she teleports to them to strike.
Focus your crowd control on her as soon as she arrives: without takedowns, her spells take a long time to come back.
forces: Very mobile thanks to her E.
Her cooldowns reset when she gets takedowns.
Huge area damage with her R.

sorts.P: Her cooldowns drop when a champion she damaged dies.
sorts.Q: Throws a dagger that bounces then lands on the ground.
sorts.W: Gains speed and tosses a dagger into the air.
sorts.E: Teleports next to a target or a dagger.
sorts.R: Spins and throws knives at the three nearest champions.

momentFort: Dangerous from level 6, and very strong in the mid game.
